data.text:
Mr. President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.,
Sir, the time has come to step down with grace and dignity. Continuing to cling to power will not serve you, nor will it serve the nation you swore to lead. It is over, sir. Allow the Philippines to heal, recover, and rebuild from the crisis we now face. Have the moral courage to choose the country—our beloved Inang Bayan—over personal and family interests. That is the final act of patriotism that history will remember.

To all Filipino compatriots, here in the Philippines and across the world: The fight is NOT over yet!. We need one more determined push until President Marcos Jr. finally steps down. The mass rally at EDSA led by UPI continues tomorrow, Tuesday, November 18, 2025, at 3:00 PM, and the “Kongresos ng Mamayang Pilipino” will continue with the global online rally and coverage of the EDSA rally. We will announce the time. With me (Anna), Harry, and Maharlika serving as moderators together with other resource persons, and our OFWs serving as moderators.

My fellow Filipinos, let us stay focused and united.
Wag tayong bibitaw (“Let’s not give up.”). We hold the line until the final call is achieved: #BBMRESIGN! 

Lahat ng ito—ang paninindigan, ang tapang, ang pagkakaisa—ay para sa Inang Bayan. (“All of this—our conviction, our courage, our unity—is for the Motherland.”). For the Philippines we love, and for the future and the future of our children we refuse to surrender. 

Mabuahy ang Pilipinas!!!🇵🇭🇵🇭🇵🇭

Please share po itong panawagan para tuloy na Edsa rally bukas po. Maraming salamat 🙏😊❤️

#BBMRESIGN
#ProPhilippines🇵🇭🇵🇭

data.text:
GOD’S HEART TV CHARITABLE OUTREACH IN THE PHILIPPINES!
God’s Heart TV Partners recently visited two less-privileged families in Negros, the fourth largest island in the Philippines, to deliver much-needed aid. The first family, living in the mountains, received essential food supplies and construction materials. The second family, led by a widow with young children whose father was recently killed, also received food supplies and financial support, bringing big smiles to the children's faces! Despite facing challenges of incessant rain and flooding rivers, our partners persevered to ensure both families were supported. This outreach is all for the glory of Jesus Christ. Thank you to everyone who made this possible!
